pages.text: Silver ore generates in every Overworld biome, rarer and deeper than tin: up to 6 veins of up to 9 blocks per chunk, between Y -48 and 48, most common around Y 0. It needs an **iron pickaxe** and drops **raw silver** (more with Fortune).
Ore smelts straight to ingots too, and 9 ingots make a block.

Alloyed with gold, silver makes [[electrum]].

If another mod already generates silver, turn Xincraft's ore off with silver.generateOre in the config.
